notes: Documentation shape only; not an external_state.py plan, manifest, deployment record or accepted backup.
A complete local instance combines reviewed Git payloads, the matching environment, private configuration, external resources and current application data.
Keep real machine roots, private manifest fingerprints and acceptance receipts outside Git. Nulls mean unknown or not verified.

environment.secret_key_source: Local remote-llm/config.json environment object, passed only to the reviewed helper child process

resources.installation_path_policy: Use current_path when supplied, otherwise path; retain upstream source filename and exact identity separately.
resources.self_trained_release_policy: Restore exact independently backed-up weights; model URLs and training source do not reproduce a completed release.
resources.preview_policy: Keep original media filenames, record/source IDs, main-preview choice and matching thumbnails together; documentation SVG never overwrites a formal binding.

mutable_data.source_choice: Select the current consistent private DB backup or reviewed Git checkpoint explicitly when creating a new runtime tree.
